jobs.title: Day Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**AbilityPath is hiring for Day Program Coordinator**

*Are you passionate about making a difference in the lives of adults with diverse abilities?*

**JOIN OUR TEAM** to facilitate site-based and community integrated group learning activities and empower adults with developmental and intellectual disabilities to lead fulfilling lives.

**Compensation: $29-$30/hour** (based on education and experience)

**Schedule:** Full Time Position, Daly City

**WHAT WE OFFER – Employee Benefits**:

At AbilityPath, we support career development, employee wellness, and recognition.

* 4 weeks of PTO
* 10 paid holidays
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits upon hire
* 401(k) plan with employer match
* Performance bonuses
* Educational reimbursement for ongoing professional development
* Mileage reimbursement

  

**WHO WE ARE**:

AbilityPath is a non-profit organization that provides a lifespan of services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Our mission is to accept, respect, and include people of all abilities. We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) learning and building an inclusive community.

**ABOUT THE ROLE – What we value:**

* **Lead & Develop Staff:** Provide mentorship, coaching, training, and supervision to instructors, interns, and volunteers.
* **Support Meaningful Programming:** Oversee curriculum planning and engaging, person-centered activities that promote independence, skill development, and community participation.
* **Coordinate Participant Services:** Support individualized goals, service planning, and collaboration with families, caregivers, and community partners.
* **Drive Program Excellence:** Partner with program leadership to ensure smooth daily operations, accurate documentation, and high-quality services.
* **Build Community Connections:** Develop partnerships that expand vocational, recreational, and community-based opportunities for participants.
* **Make a Direct Impact:** Stay connected to the individuals we serve by providing hands-on program support and instruction when needed.

  

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE:**

Below is a list of education and work experience qualifications**. We encourage you to apply even if you may not meet all the listed qualifications and you are interested in joining our team.**

* 1+ years previous work or volunteer experience supporting adults with disabilities
* Associate degree or working towards completion

**AbilityPath is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse staff; we strongly encourage BIPOC, LGBTQ+ and marginalized candidates to apply!**

**HIRING REQUIREMENTS****:**

* Valid California Driver's License/ID and license for at least 3 years if under age of 25
* Clean driving record of 3 years ( minor infractions ok)
* Proof of negative TB test results
* Verification of occupational physical clearance
* Pass a criminal fingerprint clearance
* 18 years of age or job permit clearance

  

**PHYSICAL ACTIVITY:**

Instructor responsibilities include the physical support of children:

* Physical stamina to lead learning activities: sit, stand, and bend frequently
* Ability to drive vehicle and transport adults with disabilities
* Lift up to 25 lbs. as needed

We encourage applicants to share their access needs during the interview process, upon hire, and ongoing throughout their employment. AbilityPath is committed to making our organization accessible to meet the needs of our team members.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY:**

Learning Links is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best available persons in every job. Our policy prohibits unlawful discrimination on the basis of race, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), color, national origin, gender identity, gender expression, ancestry (including language-use restrictions and possession of a driver's license), citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic characteristics, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, family care status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, legally protected medical condition, military or veteran status, or other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. AbilityPath will not tolerate any unlawful discrimination against, harassment of, or disrespectful or unprofessional conduct toward an employee based upon any of the protected characteristics listed above or based on the perception that anyone has any of those characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is **unlawful.**

jobs.title: K-8 After-School Program Coordinator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with youth and being part of a diverse, supportive, and talented community? Are you passionate about youth program development and are a natural leader? If so, please consider joining our team at Tessellations. We are currently accepting applications for a part-time K-8 After-School Program Coordinator starting immediately. Full-time summer Camp employment opportunities are available following the school year. Competitive salary available.

Tessellations is a modern, innovative Preschool-8th non-profit school for gifted learners based in Cupertino, CA. Our mission is to provide challenging experiential education that recognizes and nurtures the individual strengths of gifted learners, empowering them to confidently express who they are and pursue a meaningful life.

At Tessellations, community is a core value. A strong community was instrumental in launching our school during the pandemic and has facilitated our strong growth and success since then. Our team consists of passionate, qualified, and dedicated staff from diverse backgrounds and includes a nationally renowned gifted expert. We believe that it is time to open a new chapter in 21st-century gifted education by forging a model that fosters a cultural ecosystem within the school that promotes innovative thinking and intellectual risk-taking. Moving on from an antiquated model born during the Industrial Revolution, we favor transferable skills over compliance and rote memorization, and collaboration over competition. We believe that assessments should function as guidance for the depth and complexity of learning rather than for judgment or sorting.

**About Our After-School Program**

Our after-school program, Base Camp, provides program options for our wonderful TK - 8th grade students following the school day. We currently operate three programs, TK-Base Camp, Odyssey, and Clubs, until 6:00 pm Monday - Thursday and until 5:00 pm on Fridays. Our Odyssey and Club programs are open to K-8. Students participating in Odyssey are able to reset from a full day of instruction by engaging in self-directed indoor/outdoor play with peers, relaxing in the Oasis Room, completing homework, and or engaging in a teacher-led activity. Our enrichment Clubs are offered seasonally with offerings in the subject categories of social studies, sports and movement, world languages, arts and crafts, and STEM. Clubs typically meet once a week for 60 minutes to 120 minutes and are led by Base Camp Teachers, Tessellations Faculty, and local enrichment program vendors.

By working at Tessellations, you will work with students who love to learn, engaged parents/guardians who are grateful for your work, and supportive colleagues who will help bring out your personal best.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work Schedule: Mon-Thu: 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM; Fri 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
* Design and implement age-appropriate educational, creative, and physical enrichment activities tailored to K-8 students for our day camps.
* Create and foster a safe and nurturing learning environment where all students feel seen, heard, and included.
* Co-develop and facilitate engaging, student-centered enrichment activities spanning arts, STEM, and recreation that nurture elementary curiosity while encouraging middle school autonomy.
* Maintain an active and visible leadership presence within the department during operational hours, empowering staff and decisively addressing real-time operational needs in the Director's absence.
* Serve as the heart of our program’s connection with families, making sure parents/guardians feel well-informed, deeply supported, and actively invited into their child’s after-school journey.
* Support student self-regulation by implementing restorative methods, early de-escalation strategies, and growth-mindset praise that recognizes hard work and dedication.
* Facilitate restorative conflict resolution between peers, helping students identify feelings and communicate needs.
* Work with the other Base Camp staff to supervise the students during indoor and outdoor play, snack time, and transition periods.
* Track daily student attendance and follow secure student check-in/check-out procedures with authorized parents/guardians/caregivers.
* Maintain a safe and organized environment, supervising students closely at all times.
* Serve as a versatile team member by filling in for absent staff on short notice, seamlessly adapting to different roles and shifts to maintain continuous, high-quality operations.
* Support the Program Director with the coordination and facilitation of our academic competitions.
* Attend staff meetings and actively engage with professional development opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of elementary and middle school experience, preferably in an after-school or summer camp program setting.
* Minimum of 1 year working with transitional kindergarten, preschool, or kindergarten-aged children (experience in after-school or summer camp settings).
* Ability to actively observe, read, and accurately interpret youth’s verbal and non-verbal cues to meet their emotional and developmental needs in real-time.
* A genuine commitment to inclusive practices that welcome and celebrate families from all backgrounds.
* Strong verbal communication skills
* Passing a criminal background check upon job offer.
* Current CPR and First Aid certifications (or willingness to obtain upon hire).
* Curriculum development experience
* High school diploma or GED

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Social-emotional teaching experience
* Experience teaching gifted learners
* Proficiency with technology (G Suite in particular)
* Familiarity with and commitment to DEIJ issues
* Experience teaching twice-exceptional learners
* Connection to nature
* Enthusiastic lifelong learner
* Openness and flexibility in designing improved learning experiences

**Compensation**

Salary: $25.00 to $36.00 per hour, depending on experience

jobs.title: Community Health Worker
jobs.description:
*Empowering Wellness, Transforming Lives*

Optima Medical Management Group is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life by promoting wellness. At Optima MMG and all of its divisions: Serene Health, Community Support, and American TrueCare, our mission is to provide comprehensive support and care that not only addresses immediate concerns but also fosters long-term well-being.

As pioneers in the field, we aspire to lead in member care outcomes and set new standards for excellence and innovation. We are committed to empowering our members to achieve self-sufficiency in health, creating a ripple effect that strengthens families and communities.

Our work culture at Optima MMG is built on pride, passion, and a collective commitment to making a positive difference in people's lives. Our team members are dedicated problem-solvers who bring their unique skills and perspectives to the table. We believe that by fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, we can unlock the full potential of our team and, in turn, provide the best possible care to our members.

A career at Optima MMG is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking organization. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth, providing our employees with access to industry experts, cutting-edge technologies, and a supportive community that values each individual's contributions. Join us on this journey to not only advance your career but to be a driving force in transforming lives and communities through passionate and fulfilling work!

**Job Summary:**

The Community Health Worker (CHW) serves as a trusted liaison between community members, healthcare providers, and social service organizations. Working as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod's interdisciplinary Care Team, alongside Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs, the CHW is responsible for conducting outreach, providing health education, addressing social determinants of health, and connecting members to medical, behavioral health, and community-based resources. Under the general supervision of Enhanced Care Management Leadership, the CHW works closely with members, families, care teams, and community partners to improve health outcomes, promote self-sufficiency, and reduce barriers to care; working mainly remotely alongside the Lead Care Managers for direct member engagement. This position requires strong communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and a passion for serving diverse populations.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary team member to conduct in-person visits to community members and provide education on health-related topics.

* Assist individuals in accessing healthcare services, social services, and community resources.

* Assess social determinants of health and identify barriers impacting member well-being and healthcare access.

* Support care coordination activities and collaborate with healthcare providers, care managers, social workers, and community agencies.

* Function as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod Care Team, partnering closely with Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs who conduct direct member engagement.

* Accompany members to appointments when appropriate and assist with healthcare system, insurance program, and benefit enrollment navigation.

* Maintain ongoing contact with members through phone calls, home visits, community outreach, and telehealth platforms.

* Document member interactions, assessments, and referrals accurately and timely in designated systems.

* Advocate for members and assist with resolving barriers that interfere with access to care and services.

* Participate in community outreach events, health fairs, educational workshops, and engagement activities.

* Maintain member confidentiality and comply with all organizational and regulatory requirements.

* Participate in regularly scheduled member huddles for updates and feedback.

* Reporting in-person to the office as needed for meetings.

* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  

**Populations of Focus:**

* **Individuals experiencing homelessness:** Lacking a fixed, regular, and adequate nighttime residence.

* **Individuals at risk for avoidable hospital or emergency department utilization:** Five or more emergency room visits in a six-month period that could have been avoided with appropriate outpatient care or improved treatment adherence.

* **Individuals with Serious Mental Health and/ or substance use disorder needs:** Adults who meet the eligibility criteria for participation in, or obtaining services through Specialist mental health services or the Drug Medi-Cal organized delivery system or Drug Medi-Cal program.

* **Individuals transitioning from incarceration/Justice Involved:** Adults transitioning from a correctional setting or transitioned from a correction setting within the past 12 months, or children and youth who are transitioning from a youth correctional facility or transitioned from being in a youth correctional facility within the past 12 months.

* **Adults living in the community and at risk for long-term care institutionalization:** Adults who are living in the community who meet the SNF Level of Care criteria; or who require lower-acuity skilled nursing or equipment for prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of acute illness or injury.

* **Adult nursing facility residents transitioning to the community:** Adult nursing residents who are interested in moving out of the institution, and are likely candidates to do so successfully, and are able to reside continuously in the community.

* **Children and youth enrolled in California Children's Services (CCS) or CCS Whole Child Model (WCM) with Additional Needs Beyond the CCS condition:** Children and youth enrolled in CCS or CCS WCM and are experiencing at least one complex social factor influencing their health.

* **Children and Youth Involved in Child Welfare**

* **Individuals with Intellectual/ Developmental Disabilities:** Adu

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW:

**Experience** a place of energy, passion, and excitement. A place where the joy of discovery and uncommon artistry blend to create exhilarating buying experiences—for true beauty enthusiasts. At Ulta Beauty, we’re transforming the world one shade, one lash, one cut at a time. Because beauty is powerful.

If you seek **greater purpose**—a place of vision, mission, and lived values—where voices are heard, contributions valued and recognized and growth opportunities abound, consider Ulta Beauty. Nowhere else are the possibilities quite this beautiful.

  
:

**GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE**

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for leading through Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values in order to develop a high-performing team that consistently delivers top-line sales growth for the store. The OM leads a team of Task Associates and the Merchandise Manager (MM), and is responsible for supporting the management of the operations of a retail store, including realignments, planograms and inventory life cycle-related processes (e.g., cycle counts, damages, testers, Return To Vendors (RTV), Destroy in Field (DIF) and inventory adjustments). This leader drives the store’s retail business through a focus on performance (sales, inventory results, and operational compliance), people (talent acquisition, training and development), and process (standard operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires a passion for operational excellence, a drive for results, the ability to quickly and efficiently lead through unforeseen complexity, and the ability to lead, influence, and develop their team.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES** (\*Essential Job Functions)

The OM is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

**Performance**

* Promote a culture of accountability to meet or exceed the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), payroll, omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty for the store.
* Drive company profitability through operational excellence, top-line sales growth, and expense control.
* Leverage store forecast and payroll budgets to support with store scheduling needs and communicate the needs to the GM to maximize productivity, achieve sales and payroll goals, and complete workload (e.g., realignments, planograms, and ad set processes) on time, and within the payroll budget.
* Review, analyze and react to Ulta Beauty’s financial and operational reporting, including store visit and audit results, regularly and in a timely manner.
* Leverage company programs, tools, and resources to drive improvements to meet Ulta Beauty’s goals for the store.
* Perform makeup applications, skincare analysis, and product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and guest service experience.
* Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
* Maintain prompt, regular attendance as the OM and hold store associates accountable to the Ulta Beauty attendance policy.

**People**

* Attract, hire, and retain a diverse team of top talent, and efficiently address any staffing needs and open positions for the store.
* Build a highly engaged team at the store that embodies the Ulta Beauty brand through effective collaboration, open and honest communication, and prioritization of work.
* Create an inclusive environment that inspires and encourages the growth and engagement of associates.
* Support all aspects of manager and associate professional development, including training, providing individualized competency-based feedback and coaching, performance reviews, succession planning, and individual development plans to enable continuous development and drive sales performance.
* Regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance.
* Ensure direct reports regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance.
* Establish professional vendor partnerships that foster a shared interest in collaboratively delivering on shipment and planogram expectations.
* Model a culture of operational excellence by working alongside the leadership team and by establishing priorities, providing clear direction and support, and sharing best practices.
* Execute the Guest Engagement Leader program flawlessly through business ownership, associate coaching and leading a helpful and friendly guest experience to drive business results across all Annual Performance Goals (APGs) metrics for the store.

**Process**

* Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards for the store.
* Adhere to and enforce Ulta Beauty’s dress code.
* Ensure the execution of all operational focuses, inclusive of ad set processes, visual sets, planograms, realignments, and inventory life-cycle related processes (e.g., cycle counts, damages, testers, inventory adjustments, RTVs, and DIFs).
* Use the company’s scheduling tool as directed to adjust schedules and manage attendance in-the-moment during manager-on-duty shifts to ensure accurate schedules and reporting.
* Use the company’s task management tool as directed to prioritize and execute store workload, including product and marketing resets, pricing updates, inventory related tasks, cleaning, and replenishment.
* Manage service, boutique, and store supply inventory and ordering processes, ensuring allocated budget is adhered to, and necessary products for services and retail are on hand.

jobs.title: Financial Partnerships Operations Manager, Americas
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

**How you'll make impact**

Financial Partnerships Operations is essential to maintaining Airwallex’s relationships with financial partners as our Americas network grows. You’ll help keep live partner work moving while building the infrastructure and operating mechanisms that make the function more scalable.

* Own day-to-day operations across Airwallex’s financial partner network in the Americas, including onboarding, offboarding, account management and partner requests.
* Manage partner requirements and deliverables across Risk, Legal, Compliance, Product and Operations, using sound judgment to assess requests, identify gaps and keep things moving.
* Build scalable processes and resources to manage partner information, including repositories, playbooks, QBRs and reporting.
* Build strong relationships with financial partners and identify opportunities to improve processes and operational performance as the business grows.

This role is hybrid, based in New York, NY.

**What we're looking for**

**Essentials**

* 4+ years of experience in fintech, financial services, payments, banking or a related field.
* Experience managing complex projects and deliverables across teams such as Risk, Legal, Compliance, Product and Operations.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, dependencies and escalations through to completion.
* Strong judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to assess requests, identify gaps and push back when needed.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and external partners.
* Analytical and organized, with the ability to track performance, identify risks and work autonomously in a changing environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience with banks, payment processors, card schemes or other regulated financial institutions.
* Familiarity with KYC, KYB, due diligence or financial crime compliance.
* Understanding of payment flows, acquiring, issuing, scheme rules or technical integrations.
* Experience building scalable processes, dashboards, partner scorecards or playbooks.
* Experience using AI or automation to improve processes and reduce manual work.
* Spanish-language skills.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.
* You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.
* You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations; they're internal ones.
* You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.
* You over-communicate by design. You'd rather flag something early than let it become a surprise.
* You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

The **Senior Program Operations Manager** reports to the EOS Service Delivery Manager and provides hands-on execution and program administration support to keep the defined program of work on track.

#### **Reporting & Communication**

* Provide regular program status updates and supporting data to the EOS Service Delivery Manager, highlighting progress, risks, blockers, and items requiring client decisions.

* Experience with forecasting, budget management, financial reporting, and delivery KPIs, including on-time delivery, milestone adherence, compliance, data quality, and forecast accuracy.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, including the ability to clearly communicate risks, impacts, and recommendations.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* High integrity and discretion when handling confidential information.

### **DESIRABLE CRITERIA:**

* Working knowledge of audiovisual and video conferencing platforms, including Cisco, Neat, Zoom, and Google Meet.

* Familiarity with AV-over-IP technologies, unified communications platforms, and IT infrastructure integrations.

jobs.title: IT Specialist, Program Manager, PMO
jobs.description:
Whether you're a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

**WHY ROSENDIN?**
-----------------

**Committed. Innovative. Engaged.**
-----------------------------------

If you're looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. Since our founding over 100+ years ago, Rosendin has been driven to positively impact the communities where we live and work. We are an organization built on integrity and we have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. As one of the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractors in the United States, you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success. When our people succeed and fuel our success, we reward them. We'd love to have you as a shareholder!

  

**YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------------

As a Specialist, Program Manager - Program Management Office, you will leverage your project coordination and technology delivery experience to manage defined, lower-complexity projects and workstreams within our IT teams. You are critical to ensuring the efficient planning, coordination, and readiness of IT initiatives that support our electrical construction operations across the nation. This role plays a key part in delivering technology solutions that empower our employee-owners and drive our collective success.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* Manage lower-complexity projects and workstreams, adhering to established scope, timelines, and governance standards under senior guidance for complex issues.
* Coordinate project routines, including scheduling meetings, defining agendas, tracking actions, and ensuring timely follow-through on commitments.
* Maintain accurate project delivery controls, including integrated plans, risk and issue logs, dependency matrices, decision registers, and milestone tracking.
* Develop and distribute clear, concise status reports, dashboards, and presentation materials for project stakeholders and leadership.
* Facilitate business readiness activities, such as coordinating training sessions, preparing communication plans, assisting with testing cycles, and supporting go-live preparations.
* Proactively identify and resolve routine delivery issues within assigned projects, escalating significant risks or unresolved blockers to project or program leads.
* Ensure all project information is accurately documented and organized within approved PMO templates, processes, and repositories.
* Apply working knowledge of IT project delivery principles, enterprise applications, and Rosendin's core business processes to support successful project outcomes.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**
-------------------------------------

* Strong organizational skills to manage project details, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and ensure thorough follow-through on multiple workstreams.
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication abilities, capable of summarizing project updates, documenting decisions, and articulating technical information to diverse audiences.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies, Program Management Office (PMO) processes, and general business workflows.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, current, and well-organized project documentation and information.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams across Rosendin's business and IT departments.
Proactive problem-solving skills, including the ability to ask clarifying questions, identify gaps in information, and escalate potential risks or ambiguities early.  

  

**WHAT YOU BRING TO US**
------------------------

* 2-5 years of experience in project coordination, Program Management Office (PMO) operations, IT project delivery, or related business operations roles.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating specific projects or workstreams, including managing project plans, tracking actions, producing status reports, and supporting readiness activities.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Professional training or certifications in project management (e.g., CAPM, PMP), Agile (e.g., Scrum Master), or change management (e.g., Prosci) is preferred.  

  

**WORKING CONDITIONS**
----------------------

* Work is performed primarily in an office environment, often utilizing a computer for extended periods.
* Requires the ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 20 pounds occasionally.
* May involve occasional interaction with field personnel or visits to project sites for contextual understanding.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Rosendin is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  

  

**YOU MATTER - OUR BENEFITS**
-----------------------------

* ESOP - Employee Stock Ownership
* 401 K
* Annual bonus program based upon performance, profitability, and achievement
* 17 PTO days per year plus 10 paid holidays
* 3 days of paid sick leave each year
* 3 days of paid Bereavement leave each year
* 3 days of paid Jury Duty
* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
* Bonding Leave
* Term Life, AD&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Income Protection Insurance
* Pre-tax Flexible Spending Plans (Health and Dependent Care)
* Charitable Giving Match with our Rosendin Foundation

**Pay Range**

$91,200.00-$119,700

jobs.title: Project Manager/Foreman
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:** Established in California in 2013, Green Water and Power has rapidly grown to operate in over 35 states, positioning itself as a leader in the sustainable energy sector. Named the #1 electric vehicle (EV) installer in America, we take pride in having deployed more than 15,000 EV chargers and completed approximately 5 megawatts (MW) of solar energy projects.

As an EVITP (Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program) certified turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm, we leverage our in-house expertise to efficiently manage and execute large-scale projects. Our dedication to sustainability and quality extends beyond project completion; we also provide comprehensive operation and maintenance services to ensure optimal performance for the projects we develop, as well as for third-party installations.

**Position Overview:** Green Water and Power is seeking an experienced Project Manager/Foreman to own commercial EV charging projects while leading installation work directly on site. This role combines the hands-on technical leadership of a Foreman with the planning, and client communication of a Project Manager. You will supervise an installation crew, manage project schedules and coordinate with engineering, procurement, and local authorities, and serve as the customer’s primary point of contact. Your leadership will be crucial in delivering safe, code-compliant, high-quality installations on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage commercial EV charging projects for the entirety of the project.
* Review plan designs and single-line diagrams with the engineering department; build project schedules and crew plans for each site.
* Coordinate with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely availability and delivery of chargers, materials, and equipment.
* Obtain and finalize permits; arrange for and conduct inspections with local AHJs and coordinate utility requirements as needed.
* Schedule and lead preconstruction site walks and postconstruction site inspections.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients: coordinate start times and project schedules, provide regular updates, and resolve concerns promptly.
* Lead and supervise electrical installations for commercial EV charging systems (AC and DC), working alongside crews in the field.
* Ensure compliance with NEC, OSHA, and other safety and electrical standards.
* NEC Compliance: Strong knowledge of Article 625 and other relevant NEC standards for EV charging installations.
* Wiring and Terminations: Experience with 240V/208V circuits, wiring EVSE units to panels, and using torque tools per spec.
* Conduit and Raceway Work: Skilled in EMT and PVC conduit installation; able to bend, mount, and seal per job specs.
* Grounding and Bonding: Capable of installing compliant grounding systems for EVSE units and subpanels.
* Testing and Commissioning: Use of electrical testing tools (multimeter, insulation resistance testers, etc.) for system validation and diagnostics.
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to keep projects on track.
* Lead and mentor Junior and Senior Level EV Installers, providing guidance, technical support, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of safety within the installation teams, ensuring strict adherence to safety protocols, procedures, and best practices.
* Document punch list items, photo document progress, and submit daily status and job closeout reports to management, ensuring projects are on time and on budget.
* Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of project details, installations, maintenance activities, and repairs.
* Accountable for tools, equipment, and company vehicles, ensuring all are in good working order and that project sites are properly cleaned up.
* Must be responsive to emails and phone calls from clients, crews, and management.

**Qualifications:**

* 4-6 years of experience as an Electrical Foreman or Lead Installer, preferably in EV infrastructure or renewable energy.
* 2+ years of project management experience on commercial electrical or construction projects, including scheduling and budget tracking.
* DIR Licensed Journeyman or Master Electrician (preferred).
* Strong knowledge of the NEC, including Articles 625 and 690.
* Ability to read and interpret construction plans, specifications, and single-line diagrams.
* EVITP Certification or the ability to obtain one.
* An OSHA 30 certification or the ability to obtain one.
* Proven experience with EV charger deployment and solar panel and canopy installations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and project scheduling tools.
* Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational abilities.

**General Requirements:**

* Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and access to reliable transportation.
* Physical ability to lift and maneuver heavy equipment (up to 50 lbs.).
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* High attention to detail and safety.
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once and prioritize deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in field and office environments.
* Comfortable working outdoors, at heights, and in varying weather conditions.
* High school diploma or GED required.
* Travel is required.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary based on experience (DOE), up to $50 per hour.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package.
* Retirement Savings Plan
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Career advancement opportunities.

**Additional Information:**

* Criminal background check, pre-employment drug screen.
* This position requires travel to different job sites. Overnight stays may be necessary depending on the project location.
* Overtime and weekend work may be necessary to meet project deadlines.

jobs.title: Lead Customer Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

**Overall Purpose:**  
This position will collaborate across functions to drive adoption of Early Warning Services products. This is a client-facing role that provides technical and functional product support to external clients and assists with implementation/setup activities to ensure frictionless onboarding into the EWS ecosystem.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Lead Implementation Delivery**

* Manage and provide direction to implementation team and if appliable consultants supporting merchant integrations
* Enforce standards, QA processes, and delivery expectations
* Review implementation work to ensure consistency, quality, and adherence to best practices
* Drive accountability across timelines, deliverables, and outcomes
* Identify and address implementation friction points (e.g., redirects, latency, drop-offs)
* Implement standardized pre-launch scorecards and post-launch reviews
* Lead technical and UX design reviews with clients

**Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME)**

* Serve as escalation point for complex or high-priority implementations
* Act as the primary expert on mobile checkout and app-based implementations
* Advise external partners on optimal integration approaches
* Training and mentoring of team members on implementations, procedures and controls

**Drive Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Lead cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Design, and Operations
* Facilitate implementation reviews and readiness assessments for key launches
* Ensure learnings are captured and scaled across future integrations
* Support go/no-go decisions with clear recommendations based on implementation readiness
* Partner with product to enhance documentation, playbooks, and training materials
* Share t integration and product feedback with Product and Technology groups to influence roadmap and new product enhancements

**Build Scalable Playbooks & Standards**

* Create repeatable processes to reduce variability across external organizations
* Continuously refine best practices based on data, feedback, and evolving platform capabilities

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education and/or experience typically obtained through completion of a bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Typically 8+ years of progressive experience in integrations, product implementation, or related roles
* Strong experience with web browser and mobile app ecosystems (iOS, Android) and in-app user flows
* Proven ability to manage vendors, consultants, or cross-functional teams
* Deep understanding of digital checkout, payments, or e-commerce experiences
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on improving user experience and performance
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Background and drug screen

**Physical Requirements**

Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers.

Employee must be able to perform essential functions and physical requirements of position with or without reasonable accommodation.

The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow instructions and perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

jobs.title: Program Lead, Strategic Projects, Global Consumer CX
jobs.description:
About the Role  
  
We're looking for a highly motivated and collaborative thought leader to help shape our support strategy and drive planning and execution for Global Consumer CX. Global Consumer CX is part of Uber's Customer Advocacy & Solutions (CAS) organization and owns the end-to-end support experience for Consumers across Delivery, including Uber Eats and Grocery & Retail. Our mission is to build consumer trust through advocacy and intentional experience design. We use AI, insights, and cross-functional partnerships to deliver support when it matters most.  
  
The Program Lead, Business Planning & Enablement sits on the Global Consumer CX Strategic Projects team. This team owns planning, target setting, portfolio governance, and the operating rhythm for a global team organized around Live Order, Order Accuracy, Post Order, and Segments, Access & Policy. The team is in the middle of a shift toward end-to-end ownership of consumer journeys, defect reduction at the source, global policy consistency, and AI-first support. If things go wrong for a consumer, it's imperative they receive a best-in-class support experience. As a Program Lead, you will help shape Uber's approach to consumer customer experience, drive operational efficiency, and enable growth.  
  
This position collaborates with the Global Consumer CX leadership team and cross-functional partners, including Strategy & Planning (S&P), CX Analytics, Strategic Finance, Regional CX, Global Operations, Product, and Tech. jobs.title: Landscape Project Coordinator: PT with Room for Advancement
jobs.description:
Part-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes | East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10-12 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that +**  
**$28-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience, and our company's infrastructure.

This is a part-time position to start, with approximately **10-12 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners and our office manager to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day-to-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day-to-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the team at large.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners. You will be involved with design and sales meetings as needed, but this is not the primary function of your role.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients for their projects. This will be during active construction, as well as pre-construction.
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts as needed

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have strong practical knowledge of landscape construction, hardscape, irrigation, planting, or related construction
* Be able to read and understand plans and translate them into real-world construction
* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients
* Be kind, patient, friendly, and professional even and especially when dealing with difficult situations
* Communicate confidently and respectfully with field crews while maintaining clear expectations and a collaborative working relationship
* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail
* Notice when something isn't right and be willing to speak up
* Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Be highly organized and capable of keeping track of many moving pieces
* Be comfortable taking ownership and following things through to completion
* Understand that the details of the client experience matter just as much as the finished landscape

We are a **small, high-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth & Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owners and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day-to-day coordination as the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside our on & offsite leadership, and owners as applicable.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

We are a growing company with a collaborative team culture and a genuine commitment to the people who work with us. We care about doing excellent work, treating people well, and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding our employee benefits and opportunities, including:

* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performance-based bonuses
* Employee discounts
* PTO
* Opportunities for advancement and increasing responsibility
* A supportive, collaborative team environment
* A company culture that values communication, respect, craftsmanship, and personal growth
* Benefits currently being developed, including a 401(k) with employer matching and heal

jobs.title: Residential Care Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**T&T House of Champions | Oakland, CA**

**Residential Care & Operations Coordinator**

**Pay:** $26.00–$28.00 per hour (reviews after 90 days)  
**Schedule:** Part-Time (20+ hours per week)  
**Work Location:** In Person

**Scheduling & Shift Requirements**

**Note:** This position does not have a fixed or permanently assigned schedule. Weekly shifts will fluctuate based on staffing coverage, resident needs, and overall program operations.

Employees **must** be flexible and available to work across the following potential 8hr shifts:

* **Day:** 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
* **Evening:** 4:00 PM – 12:00 AM
* **Overnight:** 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM

A minimum of 20 hours per week is guaranteed, with opportunities for additional hours based on program and staffing needs. Shift assignments may vary weekly, and a consistent schedule or shift cannot be guaranteed.

**About T&T House of Champions**

T&T House of Champions is a Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (STRTP) in Oakland, California, serving male youth clients ages 12–17 who require intensive out-of-home placement and therapeutic support.

Our mission is to provide a safe, structured, and supportive environment where youth can develop life skills, address mental health challenges, strengthen social relationships, and prepare for successful transitions to family-based care or independent living.

**Position Summary**

T&T House of Champions is seeking a dependable, proactive, and experienced Residential Care & Operations Coordinator to support the daily care, supervision, and operational needs of our residential clients.

This hands-on position combines direct client care with facility operations and administrative support. The individual will work under the direction of organizational leadership to help maintain a safe, structured, therapeutic, and well-managed residential environment.

The ideal candidate is adaptable, organized, accountable, and comfortable balancing the needs of clients and daily facility operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Direct Resident Care & Supervision**

* Provide direct supervision, guidance, and support to youth clients
* Promote a safe, structured, and therapeutic living environment
* Assist youth with daily living skills, personal development, and positive decision-making
* Support emotional regulation, social development, and independent living skills
* Respond appropriately to behavioral concerns and crisis situations in accordance with program protocols

**Facility Operations & Coordination**

* Support daily facility operations and help maintain a clean, safe, and organized environment
* Assist with daily routines, household activities, supplies, inventory, and facility needs
* Provide day-to-day guidance and support to direct care staff, as assigned
* Assist with shift coordination, staff communication, and smooth transitions between shifts
* Identify and communicate operational, maintenance, and safety concerns to organizational leadership

**Documentation & Program Support**

* Maintain accurate resident progress notes, daily logs, incident reports, and required documentation
* Communicate resident observations, concerns, and progress to the treatment team
* Follow established medication procedures within applicable training and authorization requirements
* Support organizational compliance with agency policies and applicable California STRTP licensing requirements
* Develop and facilitate recreational, educational, social, and life-skills activities
* Accompany youth to appointments and community resources as assigned
* Participate in mandatory meetings, trainings, and ongoing professional development

**Minimum Qualifications & Requirements**

Candidates must meet at least one of the education and experience pathways, subject to applicable STRTP requirements:

* Must successfully complete required federal and state fingerprint-based criminal background clearances, including applicable FBI and California Department of Justice (DOJ) fingerprint checks, and meet all applicable STRTP clearance requirements
* Must be at least 21 years of age
* Must possess a valid California driver's license and maintain a driving record that meets organizational insurance and driving requirements
* Bachelor's degree or valid Child Development Teaching Permit
* At least 12 semester units in a relevant field plus 100 hours of youth experience
* Qualifying Alcohol/Drug Counselor certificate or vocational credential, with required youth experience
* At least one year of experience working or volunteering in a licensed group home or STRTP
* Other CDSS-approved education and experience combinations, where applicable

**Additional Requirements:**

* Must be willing and able to transport youth to appointments, activities, community resources, and other destinations as assigned
* Must be available to drive for other organizational business and operational needs as necessary
* Knowledge of community resources and support services
* Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
* Ability to maintain professional boundaries, confidentiality, and sound judgment
* Flexibility to work day, evening, and overnight shifts based on program needs
* Must attend mandatory monthly trainings for ongoing education and professional development

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with adolescents, at-risk youth, or individuals with behavioral or mental health needs
* Experience in a group home, STRTP, residential treatment, or behavioral health setting
* Previous leadership, staff coordination, or facility operations experience
* Knowledge of trauma-informed care, crisis intervention, and de-escalation techniques

Pay: $26.00 - $29.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 20.0 per week

Work Location: In person

Description:

**Title:** Kinder Care Coordinator  
**Organization:** Boys and Girls Clubs of San Leandro  
**Location:** Searles Elementary School, 33629 15th St, Union City, CA  
**Department:** Programming

**Reports to:** Program Manager

**Direct Reports:** Kinder Youth Development Professionals (TK/K-YDPs)

**Position Overview:**

The KinderCare Coordinator (KCC) leads the Transitional Kindergarten/Kindergarten (TK/K) program for children ages 3-6, creating a safe, engaging, and enriching space where young learners can grow. This role ensures that every child’s experience is joyful, developmentally appropriate, and supports their early learning journey. By guiding and inspiring the Youth Development Professionals (YDPs) on their team, the KCC helps shape a high-quality program that fosters curiosity, confidence, and connection.

The KCC plays a key role in advancing our organization’s mission by ensuring young children receive thoughtful care and intentional learning experiences in their critical early years. Through strong leadership and collaboration, they support staff, work alongside teachers, and cultivate an environment where children feel secure, valued, and excited to learn.

What makes this role unique is its blend of leadership, mentorship, and hands-on impact with young children. The KCC is not just managing a program—they are building a foundation for lifelong learning by empowering both students and staff to thrive.

**Our Values in Action:**

**Transformative Leadership:** We aspire to transform possibilities into probabilities. By embodying emotional intelligence, vulnerability, and empathy, we foster positive change with humility, authenticity, and continuous self-improvement.

* *What that looks like in this role:* Empowering YDPs through clear guidance, support, and encouragement. Leading with empathy, patience, and emotional intelligence to foster a positive team culture. Building strong relationships with teachers, families, and staff to create a unified program. Communicating clearly and transparently, ensuring alignment on expectations and goals.

**Resilience:** We approach every situation with a growth mindset, demonstrating flexibility and courage, reframing challenges as opportunities. We acknowledge our current state, embrace change, and adapt as needed, maintaining a solutions-oriented approach throughout our growth journey.

* *What that looks like in this role:* Adapting quickly to challenges while maintaining program quality. Approaching obstacles with a growth mindset and a solutions-focused attitude. Supporting staff through challenges, providing guidance and encouragement. Fostering a supportive, team-first culture, ensuring YDPs feel valued and motivated.

**Youth Centered Approach:** Every organizational action or maneuver is designed to directly impact and benefit the youth we serve. We value and prioritize the youth perspective, making decisions with a focus on their needs and well-being, rather than adult convenience.

* *What that looks like in this role:* Designing activities that are engaging, age-appropriate, and enriching. Listening to and incorporates children's voices in program decisions. Creating an inclusive, safe, and welcoming environment for all children. Cultivating a positive and rewarding space where children thrive.

**Essential Functions:**

* **Leadership & Staff Development**: Guide and support Youth Development Professionals (YDPs) in delivering a high-quality TK/K program through training, coaching, and ongoing feedback to enhance staff performance.
* **Program Implementation & Engagement**: Oversee learning and play activities that align with BGCSL and BGCA methodologies, ensuring meaningful and developmentally appropriate experiences for children.
* **Early Childhood Development Outcomes**: Monitor each child’s progress toward TK/K early childhood development milestones through structured learning and play.
* **After-School Program Support**: Assist in the broader after-school program implementation as needed to strengthen overall program quality and success.
* **Safety & Emergency Preparedness**: Implement and oversee emergency procedures, safety drills, and compliance requirements to maintain a secure and well-regulated environment.
* **Incident Documentation & Compliance**: Support and document incident investigations, maintain safety records, and ensure adherence to reporting and compliance requirements.
* **Professional Development & Best Practices**: Attend meetings and training to stay current on early childhood education best practices, integrating new approaches to improve program effectiveness.
* **Child Progress Monitoring & Assessment**: Track children's development through observations and assessments, using data to inform and enhance learning experiences.

Requirements:

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Required:**

* Education: Minimum of 48 college units or an associate degree (AA) in a related field.
* Experience with Children: At least 2 years of experience working with children ages 3-6 in an educational or childcare setting.
* Leadership Experience: At least 2 years of experience leading, coaching, mentoring, or coordinating frontline staff or teams in a youth development or educational environment.
* Demonstrated ability to motivate teams, provide day-to-day guidance and feedback, and lead others toward shared program goals.
* Commitment to Early Childhood Education: Strong dedication to child development and high-quality early learning experiences.
* Willingness to Learn & Grow: Positive attitude toward continuous learning, skill development, and professional training.
* Preferred:
* Formal supervisory experience in a previous role.
* Education: A bachelor’s degree (B.S./B.A.) in early childhood educatio

Partnering closely with internal stakeholders across planning, procurement, logistics, and finance, you will oversee product planning operations that empower Google's expanding cloud infrastructure. Additionally, you will drive cross-functional collaboration to define requirements for new workflows and software platforms, aligning key teams to facilitate strategic decision-making and support sustainable, efficient, and predictable growth.

This team is responsible for enabling and accelerating Google's data center infrastructure growth and delivery through AI-Powered Supply Chain Planning for all of Google, drive planning decisions for new technology, and supply capability across data centers, networking, and machines. The team focuses on driving the forecasting, demand and supply planning, execution capability/feasibility management of data center compute & storage infrastructure products.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================

Ramp's Mid-Market Customer Success Managers on the Lifecycle team don't stop at go-live — they make sure customers keep getting more from Ramp as their business grows. Ramp has grown its product suite significantly over the last several years. As we've matured as an organization, our customer relationships have grown more complex too: customers are buying more of the platform at once, running it across more entities and teams, and relying on it for more of how their finance function operates. Hitting an activation milestone doesn't mean the job's finished. Too often, a feature that could solve a real problem goes unused because no one is there to show how it would work in that customer's business.

That's where you come in. This is a role for people who understand how finance teams actually run, who think in years rather than quarters, and who already use AI the way surgeons use instruments: not occasionally, not as an experiment, but as the default way they work. You'll own the customer experience after implementation for a book of mid-market customers, partnering with Account Management on long-term account strategy. You'll also be one of the first Lifecycle CSMs on a newly formed team, helping define how Ramp earns and keeps the trust of its customers.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the post-implementation experience for a book of mid-market customers, with clear accountability for sustained adoption, customer satisfaction, and renewal readiness
* Drive sustained adoption by understanding each customer's goals and guiding them toward the workflows that improve outcomes for their business — including the products and features they've already purchased but haven't fully put to work
* Act as each customer's expert in finance workflows: understand how they run their business, advise on decisions as their needs change, and make the value of new Ramp capabilities clear in their context
* Build multi-threaded relationships in every account, including finance leadership relationships you own, so the account stays steady through change like a new Controller or CFO
* Partner with Account Management on QBRs and business reviews, quantifying Ramp's impact in the language CFOs and Controllers care about — close cycle improvement, spend visibility, savings, and ROI — not just product usage metrics
* Spot opportunities for growth and bring them to Account Management, who owns renewals and expansion; as customers add products, drive ongoing activation so they reach value quickly
* Run your book on data: monitor usage, CP, and risk signals, prioritize where your time goes, and get ahead of challenges and escalations before they reach renewal
* Use AI tools daily to prepare for customer calls, build materials, synthesize data, identify account risk, and operate at a pace traditional methods can't match
* Bring customer feedback back into Ramp — surfacing patterns, gaps, and opportunities from your accounts to shape how Ramp evolves
* Turn what works into repeatable plays, programs, and automations that scale across your book and the team

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 5+ years of customer-facing experience in customer success, account management, or consulting, with a proven, consistent track record of retaining customers and exceeding goals
* Experience owning a book of customers past launch and through renewal, with measurable retention, adoption, or satisfaction results; finance or fintech context is a plus but not required
* A customer experience mindset — you get ahead of problems before customers raise them and own escalations through resolution
* AI fluency as a daily habit — you already use AI tools habitually to prep for calls, synthesize information, build customer-facing materials, and automate repetitive tasks; this is how you work, not something you're exploring
* Ability to communicate Ramp's impact in financial terms — walking a Controller through the value Ramp has delivered and connecting adoption to P&L outcomes
* A data-driven approach to managing a book — you prioritize based on usage, revenue, and risk signals and can spot an at-risk account well before renewal
* Technical and systems acumen to understand how Ramp fits into a customer's finance stack, diagnose what's blocking adoption, and bring in the right technical partner
* A builder mindset — this team is new, and you're energized by shaping the playbooks, programs, and rituals that define how Lifecycle CSMs work while running your own book; you bring structure to ambiguity and iterate quickly
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills across Sales, Account Management, Product, Operations, and other GTM teams

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Experience with a consumption-based product where value is measured in usage or spend, not seats
* Exposure to FP&A, accounting software ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage, QuickBooks, Xero), expense management, or CFO-adjacent workflows
* Demonstrated commercial impact — rete

We are looking for a highly motivated and results-oriented Enterprise Account Manager to drive growth and revenue within an assigned portfolio of enterprise accounts. This is a sales-focused role where you will be responsible for not only managing a designated book of business of existing client relationships but also identifying and capitalizing on upsell and cross-sell opportunities to maximize revenue. As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for key enterprise clients, delivering tailored solutions that align with their strategic goals and driving the overall growth of the accounts and success of the partnerships.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* Sales Leadership & Account Growth: Take full ownership of an assigned book of business, with the primary responsibility to drive sales growth by identifying new opportunities within existing accounts through upselling and cross-selling.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.
