jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**About Sycamore**
==================

Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need.

We are a small, engineering-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders.

**The role**
============

Strategy & Operations at Sycamore is a generalist role for someone who is good at reducing messy problems to clear decisions and then making the decision stick. There is no fixed remit. In a given quarter the highest-leverage work might be the model that decides how we price a deployment, the reporting that tells us whether deployments are actually succeeding, the planning cycle that sets company priorities, or an internal process that is quietly costing everyone hours.

You will work directly with the founders and with engineering, commercial, and recruiting leaders. Most of the work is analytical: getting the data, understanding what it says, and forming a recommendation you are willing to defend. The rest is operational follow-through, which is where most of the value is and where most people stop. The scope grows with what you demonstrate.

**What you will do**
====================

* Own analytical and operational problems end to end, from framing through recommendation through implementation.
* Run company planning, goal setting, and the review cadence that keeps them honest.
* Design and improve internal processes and systems across finance, recruiting operations, vendor management, and commercial operations.
* Support pricing, deal structuring, and commercial analysis alongside the go-to-market team.
* Find the work nobody owns yet, take it on, and hand it off well once it is systematized.
* Write clearly for an audience of founders, engineers, and customers.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* 4-10 years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, banking, product operations, or a generalist role at a high-growth company. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction.
* Strong analytical ability. You can build a model, query data directly, and tell the difference between a real signal and an artifact of how the data was collected.
* Evidence of operational follow-through. You have implemented recommendations, not only produced them.
* Comfort with ambiguity and no established playbook. Much of this role is deciding what deserves attention.
* Clear writing. Your recommendations should be understandable to someone who was not in the room.
* Technical fluency. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data yourself and understand what our product does at more than a surface level.
* AI-native. You use modern AI systems and agents to expand your own throughput, while owning the judgment and the conclusions.
* High integrity with numbers. You would rather present an uncomfortable finding than a flattering one.

**Interview process**
=====================

* A 30-minute introductory conversation.
* Two 60-minute conversations, one on analytical problem solving and one on operational judgment.
* A working session where you take a real, open Sycamore problem, do the analysis, and present a recommendation you would be willing to own.

**Why join**
============

* Work directly with the founders on the decisions that shape the company.
* Take on genuinely varied problems rather than one narrow function.
* Build the operating foundation of a company early enough that it compounds.
* Work alongside engineers building something technically hard, in a company where operations is expected to keep up.
* Receive competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity in the company you are helping build.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Our software solves the most critical emerging grid integration challenges to ensure that the impending energy transition is clean, equitable, and resilient. Our enterprise solutions help the grid absorb the coming electrification wave with ease. Utilizing modern, cloud-native platform architecture and robust systems optimization, WeaveGrid’s software is built from the ground up to tackle the most critical network challenges while meeting the stringent regulatory, security, and reliability requirements of the utility industry.

**About the role**
------------------

We are seeking a devoted, empathetic, and thoughtful Customer Experience (CX) Associate to join our Customer Operations Team and serve as an ambassador to our customer participant base. The CX Associate is our closest link to our customers, and a critical contributor to their journey with WeaveGrid.

The person stepping into the role will be responsible for creating a stellar experience for our customers participating in our serviced utility programs. They will be directly responsible for triaging, answering, and resolving tickets, as well as summarizing and sharing feedback from customers. This will require becoming deeply familiar with both our application functionality and driver needs. This role is hybrid, with in-office days on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

As specific responsibilities, the CX Associate will:

* Respond to customer inquiries and requests over email and other channels, adhering to our Customer Support guidelines and SLAs.
* Appropriately escalate specific issues, as needed, in a timely manner
* Identify and flag gaps in resources and content that would help drivers resolve problems quickly and easily
* Document issues to help Engineering and Product teams resolve specific bugs
* Gather, summarize, and share insights on customer needs, preferences, concerns, and perspectives to help improve the user experience and ensure the team’s work is maximizing value for customers
* Send email campaigns to proactively address emerging issues, program updates, or other ad hoc requests
* Process customer incentives accurately and on time, troubleshooting any payment or eligibility discrepancies as they arise
* Create and own help center articles and customer-facing content, keeping materials up to date as products, policies, and FAQs evolve

### **About You**

You are a customer experience professional or community lead who has served on the front lines of startup consumer products. You have 1-2 years of experience in Customer Operations or Customer Support. You love delighting the customers you support and take great pride in ensuring they are satisfied with the assistance received.

You are familiar with translating complex technical concepts into clear, digestible explanations for non-technical users — whether that's walking a customer through how something works in detail, or writing help center content that lets customers self-serve.

You can nimbly engage with users while effectively advocating for new features inspired by their feedback. In managing a backlog of user tickets, you identify common issues to be prioritized and addressed through platform content and product enhancements.

You keep a close eye on indicators of user satisfaction, including CSAT, ticket response, and resolution times. You focus relentlessly on actions that provide the highest leverage for keeping users happy.

You are considerate, enthusiastic, and precise in your communications. You are determined and methodical when investigating issues — a sleuth constantly assembling a clear record of facts and underlying circumstances around reported issues, so that you can respond effectively and empower colleagues to do the same.

Some of the specific skills and traits you bring include:

* Familiarity with common customer service software platforms (like Zendesk) and common productivity tools (Gdocs, JIRA, etc.)
* Passion for helping users
* Clear and succinct communication skills with technical concepts
* Strong organization and structure in your work
* Basic proficiency in standard tools for data entry and tracking (like Excel / Gsheets)
* Experience with AI tools or agents is a nice-to-have
* Comfort working under conditions of ambiguity and loosely defined requirements, which can be common in the startup environment
* A deep hunger for ongoing learning and personal growth
* A passion for decarbonization and reducing global climate risk

**The total compensation for this opportunity includes a base salary range of $70,000 - $82,000 plus equity (stock options) and benefits. This is our target compensation range and is subject to multiple factors including role, level, experience, skill, and location.** As you go through our interview process, our recruiter will work with you to identify a competitive base salary within the proposed range and combine it with an equity package to get you excited about your future at WeaveGrid.

Compensation Range: $70K - $82K

### **Why TrueAccord?**

TrueAccord, a wholly owned subsidiary of TrueML, is a category-defining company. Join our Implementation team as a Sr. Implementation Specialist, a high-impact, execution-focused role built for a driven coordinator looking to launch a career in Technical Project Management. You will play a dual role: independently leading end-to-end onboarding for our smaller, standardized clients while providing essential organizational support for our largest Enterprise launches. Your ultimate goal is to ensure seamless, accurate client launches and keep complex implementation workflows moving smoothly on schedule.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Lead Growth Client Launches**: Independently manage the end-to-end onboarding for small-scale "Growth CSV" clients, executing fast, accurate, and repeatable short-term workflows.
* **Support Enterprise Implementations**: Partner closely with Senior Implementation Managers as their primary support lead, handling the organizational and logistical heavy lifting for complex, large-scale client launches.
* **Own Documentation & Governance:** Serve as the team's lead Document Manager by creating and maintaining RAIDS logs, project folders, and central document repositories.
* **Drive Project Momentum & Visibility:** Own daily and weekly task lists, escalate potential timeline risks early, orchestrate meetings with clear agendas, and distribute weekly status updates and action items.
* **Facilitate Cross-Functional Alignment:** Coordinate syncs and track deliverables across internal teams with sharp attention to detail, enabling senior leaders to stay focused on high-level strategy.

### **Who You Are:**

* **Aspiring Technical Project Manager:** Early-to-mid-career coordinator with foundational analytical skills who thrives in structured, repeatable workflows and is eager to grow into complex project management.
* **Detail-Oriented & Tactical:** Highly organized and reliable when executing clearly defined project tasks on tight timelines (days to weeks).
* **Strong Communicator & Collaborator:** Comfortable leading meetings, writing clear status updates, and aligning stakeholders across internal teams.
* **Coachable & Process-Minded:** Works well within established processes and proactively seeks guidance when encountering complex edge cases outside of standard playbooks.
* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. (No formal certifications like a PMP or regulatory background required; exposure to technical environments is a bonus!)

For U.S.-based hires, the overall base salary framework for this role currently spans **$80,000 to $90,000** per year. The applicable base salary range for any individual hire depends on the geographic labor market associated with the employee’s primary work location along with other factors such as relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.  
  
Geographic labor markets are divided into "tiers" based upon a number of factors, including cost of living. Below, you'll find a few example cities representative of each tiers:

* **U.S. Geo Tier 1** (i.e. San Francisco, New York City, Boston)
* **U.S. Geo Tier 2** (i.e.Austin, Denver, Phoenix)
* **U.S. Geo Tier 3** (i.e.Kansas City, Jacksonville, Indianapolis)

We encourage you to speak to your recruiter to learn more about our compensation philosophy as well as discuss our benefits, total rewards, and opportunities for growth.

### **What We Offer (Perks & Benefits)**

* Flexible vacation
* Medical/dental/vision insurance
* Traditional/Roth retirement savings options
* Company-paid disability and life insurance
* Flexible Spending Account & Limited FSA
* Family-friendly parental leave, volunteer and voting time off
* On-demand wellness platform access for you and 5 friends and family
* PerkSpot discount program for 900+ merchants nationwide
  

### **Recruiting Fraud Notice:**

We’re aware of fraudulent recruiters posing as TrueAccord or TrueML and contacting job seekers. To protect yourself, here’s how our real hiring process works:

* **Official channels only.** Our recruiters email only from @trueaccord.com [If you’ve received an InMail, you should verify the recruiter’s @trueaccord.com email]

* **No payments or financial info during hiring.** We will never ask you to pay fees, buy equipment, or share banking information during the hiring process.

* **No text or chat-app interviews.** We do not conduct interviews by text message or messaging apps.

* **No “portals” or access keys.** We do not send PDF portals or access keys, or ask for passwords or login credentials.

* **No resume services.** We will never require an “ATS-friendly” resume rewrite or recommend paid resume services.

If someone contacting you on our behalf does any of the above, it is fraud.

**Stay safe:**

* Don’t open attachments, click links, or share personal information.
* Report the message as phishing to your email provider, and report fake profiles to LinkedIn.
* Not sure? Verify by emailing recruiting@trueaccord.com before responding.

**If you’ve already shared information with suspected scammers:** Contact your bank, visit identitytheft.gov, and report the fraud at reportfraud.ftc.gov or ic3.gov.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT OLIPOP**

At OLIPOP, we're on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we're doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that's delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn't be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben's vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we're also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we're committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let's write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

### **THE ROLE**

In this role, you will be intimately involved in the production process from start to finish. This starts with managing all things quality at both our premixing facilities, as well as finished good co-packers. The Quality Manager will be responsible for the design and management of the quality systems used to assure food safety, regulatory compliance and reliable product manufacturing with our USA suppliers, contract manufacturers and fulfillment partners.

* Own the supplier qualification, approval, and compliance program, ensuring suppliers and materials meet established quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements.

* Lead supplier audits and facility assessments and drive continuous improvement through strong supplier partnerships.

**Ingredient Quality Management**

* Own the ingredient positive release program, including COA review, material disposition, and communication with warehouses and internal stakeholders.

* Establish risk-based ingredient testing and verification programs to ensure materials consistently meet established quality and food safety specifications.

* Oversee ingredient retain and traceability programs to support quality investigations and supplier performance evaluation.

* Lead ingredient nonconformance investigations and drive appropriate supplier corrective actions and material disposition.

* Monitor ingredient quality trends and variability to proactively identify and mitigate emerging risks.

**Quality Systems & Document Control**

* Own document control processes for Quality and Supply Chain documentation, including SOPs, forms, specifications, and work instructions.

* Establish and enforce standards for document creation, review, approval, version control, archival, and retention.

* Ensure supplier compliance records are complete, current, and audit-ready.

* Lead periodic document reviews with cross-functional process owners to ensure procedures accurately reflect current practices and requirements.

* Drive continuous improvement of quality systems and documentation processes to strengthen compliance, traceability, and efficiency.

**Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and own supplier performance metrics and scorecards to monitor quality, compliance, recurring issues, and emerging risks.

* Analyze supplier and ingredient quality trends to identify systemic risks and continuous improvement opportunities.

* Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain leadership on supplier approval, performance, escalation, and disqualification decisions.

* Provide leadership visibility to supplier quality risks, significant nonconformances, and unresolved corrective actions.

* 0-2 years of experience managing and developing technical team m

**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

  
  

**Manager, Web Partnerships and Enablement**

  
  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

The Amgen Global Customer Capabilities & Innovation organization is looking for a Manager, Web Partnerships and Enablement to extend web expertise and scale support for new and emerging demand across Medical, Corporate Affairs, Clinical Trials, R&D, and approved non-commercial needs. The role provides strategy, governance, and delivery leadership so teams can apply enterprise web standards and capabilities to their needs.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Portfolio governance and launch readiness -** Guide web portfolio governance and provide launch readiness support for Medical, Corporate Affairs, Clinical Trials, R&D, and approved non-commercial web initiatives. Clarify governance requirements, decision points, owners, and readiness needs, and help teams navigate the appropriate web delivery processes.

* **Strategic Web Program Lead -** Serve as a subject-matter expert on CMS, Design System, back-end system integrations, pharmaceutical web marketing best practices and emerging trends. Advise business teams on how to apply current web capabilities to business objectives and audience needs, and identify opportunities to strengthen digital experiences. Translate business goals into strategic recommendations and proactively define future-state capability enhancements and roadmaps, partnering with business, technology, content, design, analytics, and agency teams to assess feasibility, value, and dependencies.

* **Standards and platform transitions -** Promote adoption of enterprise web standards and governance. Assess externally hosted or custom web platforms and help plan their transition toward global web enterprise standards, including alignment on scope, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder responsibilities.

* **Vendor and procurement enablement -** Advise teams on engaging web vendors and agencies. Support statement-of-work development and procurement planning for web services, including Analytics and SEO engagements, in coordination with relevant procurement and business partners.

* **Portfolio Prioritization & Planning:** Lead quarterly intake and prioritization of web initiatives with Technology and business stakeholders, aligning investment to enterprise strategy, business value, and resource capacity. Translate prioritized needs into actionable scope, requirements, sequencing, timelines, and delivery plans. Assess cross-project and platform dependencies, clarify ownership, and apply governance to support informed prioritization and delivery.

* **Web Delivery & Release Management:** Lead cross-functional web initiatives from approved plans through development, launch, and hypercare. Coordinate creative and content handoffs, development, approvals, QA/UAT, deployment, and production validation. Align timelines, resources, budgets, dependencies, and release requirements; establish launch readiness; facilitate decisions; resolve issues; and communicate status and escalations to support successful, timely delivery.

Embed legal, regulatory, privacy, accessibility, brand, and operational resilience requirements throughout delivery, escalating material risks as needed.

* **Performance & Continuous Improvement:** Partner with analytics and SEO teams to interpret web traffic, user behavior, search performance, and other digital insights, and use findings to recommend website optimization. Lead structured retrospectives and apply performance insights, lessons learned, and emerging trends to recommend improvements to web capabilities, standards, tools, templates, and delivery processes. Scale effective practices to improve consistency, efficiency, collaboration, and speed to market..
  

  

**WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Web Strategist professional we seek is a collaborator with these qualifications.

Doctorate degree and 2 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

OR

**Make an impact**

  

The Program Manager, Technical Solutions owns the business platforms that support Bridge Property Management’s maintenance, capital expenditure (CapEx), and annual budgeting processes. This role leads the implementation of BPM's next-generation maintenance platform, partners with the CapEx team to extend our CapEx platform to the unit renovation process, and manages the annual budgeting platform.

Acting as the technical partner to the VP Service & Facilities, the CapEx Director, and Asset Management, the Program Manager translates platform capabilities into better business processes, resolves technical issues, and uses automation to improve how site teams, CapEx teams, and asset managers work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintenance Platform Ownership: Lead the planning, configuration, testing, rollout, and adoption of BPM’s next-generation maintenance platform, including the transition from the legacy application. Understand how site teams perform against maintenance KPIs such as work order response, completion, and unit turn times, and use that insight to shape configuration, reporting, and improvements.

* CapEx Platform Ownership: Own the CapEx platform and partner with the CapEx Director to extend it from exterior projects to the unit renovation process, including workflow design, configuration, and rollout.

* Budget Platform Ownership: Own the annual budgeting platform, including configuration, user access, and technical support through the budget cycle. Support the Operations, CapEx, and Asset Management teams as they build and enter their budgets.

* Process Optimization & Automation: Identify opportunities to improve maintenance, CapEx, and budgeting processes through platform capabilities and automation, and communicate what the systems can do so business leaders can make better decisions.

* Platform Support & Vendor Management: Manage user access and permissions, resolve technical issues, and manage vendor relationships, including release testing, support, and escalation.

* Program Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams to deliver platform initiatives with detailed plans, timelines, and resource allocations.

* Training, Adoption & Change Management: Partner with Talent Development to design and deliver training, and lead change management for platform updates and rollouts.

* Stakeholder Engagement: Hold regular reviews with the VP Service & Facilities, CapEx Director, and Asset Management on project progress, platform health, and KPIs.

* Governance, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure platforms meet internal policies, data governance standards, and security protocols, and maintain documentation for configurations, processes, and training materials.

**What you should bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field

* 5 years of experience in program or project management within a business technology or enterprise applications environment

* Experience with property management service and maintenance platforms such as HappyCo, SuiteSpot, Yardi Maintenance IQ, EliseAI Maintenance, or SmartOps

* Demonstrated process optimization experience, including the use of automation to improve workflows

* Experience leading platform implementations from planning through adoption

* Ability to translate business needs into platform configuration and communicate system capabilities to non-technical leaders

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

* Experience with CapEx, project management, or budgeting platforms

* Familiarity with maintenance KPIs in multifamily or residential property management

* PMP or similar certification

**What you can be a part of**  
As Program Manager, Technical Solutions, you’ll lead the rollout of Bridge Property Management’s next-generation maintenance platform, extend our CapEx platform to unit renovations, and own the annual budgeting platform. As the technical partner to the VP Service & Facilities, the CapEx Director, and Asset Management, you’ll turn platform capabilities into better processes and use automation to make life easier for site teams, CapEx teams, and asset managers. If you enjoy owning business-critical platforms and seeing your work improve how people get things done every day, this is a chance to make a visible, lasting impact.

  

The anticipated wage scale for this role is $104,000 - $130,000 per year. The hired applicant will also be eligible for an annual performance based discretionary bonus. The final pay offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and years of experience within the job, the type of years and experience within the industry, education, etc. Bridge Property Management is a multi-state employer, and this pay scale may not reflect positions that work in other states or locations.

This position works closely with User Experience (UX) Research teams, Engineering, vendors, and cross functional stakeholders to streamline purchasing workflows, manage procurement initiatives, and drive operational efficiency.

* Build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to monitor vendor utilization, purchasing activity, and operational performance.

Avalara is transforming tax compliance into a seamless, automated digital experience. Within our Micro & Emerging Business unit, we are building a unified self-serve compliance platform for small merchants and lodging operators by bringing DAVO and MyLodgeTax together.

As a **Senior Program Manager**, you will lead the cross-functional operations of this flagship initiative. You will drive alignment, accountability, and execution across dedicated engineering teams, central platform groups, business development, billing systems, and shared services. Reporting to Evan Wright (VP & GM, SMB Business), this role gives you startup-style agility and scope backed by the data, customers, and infrastructure of an established global SaaS leader.

**Lead program delivery.** Own the integrated plan, milestones, and critical path for the DAVO and MyLodgeTax consolidation, including the platform rebuild, customer migration, and security and compliance deadlines.

**Run the cross-team operating model.** Set up operating rhythms, dependency maps, and clear service agreements with engineering, central platform, business development, filing operations, and corporate systems teams.

**Drive billing and systems work.** Coordinate roadmaps and delivery for card and ACH checkout, self-serve pricing and quoting, HubSpot, ERP integrations, and the APIs underneath them.

**Align partner integrations.** Coordinate timelines across POS and property-management integrations, marketplace apps, and integration partners so customers can sign up and onboard without talking to sales.

**Give executives clear visibility.** Build dashboards tracking self-serve conversion, support volume, and acquisition economics, and write decision memos that make trade-offs easy to act on.

jobs.title: Strategic Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About Team / Role**

This role leads complex, high-impact strategic projects, operational transformations, and technology-enabled initiatives across Health, Corporate Payments, and Mobility. The role manages advanced initiatives from definition through implementation and stabilization, often spanning multiple business lines, operational functions, systems, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  
  

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Strategic Operations Lead translates complex or ambiguous business needs into structured programs of work, establishes governance and accountability, manages significant risks and dependencies, and drives decisions necessary to achieve intended business outcomes.

  
  

The role combines advanced project management and operational expertise to identify and lead opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, redesign, or eliminate inefficient processes. This role also advances AI and automation capabilities across the organization by identifying high-value opportunities, leading complex implementations, and ensuring measurable and sustainable business benefits.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

  
  

### **PROJECT MANAGEMENT & DELIVERY**

* ### **Lead complex, high-impact projects and operational transformations, including initiatives spanning multiple business lines, functions, systems, or workstreams, from definition through implementation and stabilization.**
* ### **Translate ambiguous or evolving business needs into clear scope, objectives, deliverables, governance, resource requirements, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.**
* ### **Establish and lead project governance, executive reporting, decision management, and risk and issue escalation appropriate to the complexity and impact of assigned initiatives.**
* ### **Coordinate cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, establishing clear ownership and driving decisions where priorities, requirements, or accountabilities conflict.**
* ### **Anticipate and manage significant risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and downstream impacts, developing recommendations and corrective actions when project health is at risk.**
* ### **Ensure operational requirements, financial and operational controls, capacity, business continuity, training, documentation, and implementation readiness are addressed before launch.**
* ### **Lead implementation and stabilization and validate that intended outcomes, sustainable business ownership, and appropriate performance measures are established.**

  
  

### **PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & OPERATIONAL TRANSFORMATION**

  
  

* ### **Lead complex process improvement and operating-model initiatives spanning multiple teams, business lines, systems, or functional boundaries.**
* ### **Analyze workflows, data, financial exposure, operational incidents, control findings, and stakeholder feedback to identify systemic issues and root causes.**
* ### **Design and implement future-state processes that improve capacity, quality, service, controls, risk management, and scalability.**
* ### **Identify opportunities to standardize or consolidate processes across business lines where common solutions can reduce fragmentation, duplication, and manual effort.**
* ### **Establish measurable business outcomes and validate that expected operational, financial, capacity, risk, and service benefits are realized.**

  

### **AI, AUTOMATION & TECHNOLOGY ENABLEMENT**

  
  

* ### **Identify and lead high-value opportunities to apply AI, automation, analytics, and technology across business lines to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and risk detection, increase capacity, and strengthen management visibility.**
* ### **Partner with operational leaders, Product, Technology, and automation resources to translate complex business problems into scalable technology-enabled solutions.**
* ### **Lead complex automation initiatives through requirements, prioritization, testing, implementation, controls, adoption, and stabilization.**
* ### **Challenge existing processes before automation to ensure technology supports effective future-state workflows rather than replicating inefficient manual activity.**
* ### **Establish measurable outcomes automation initiatives, including capacity released, financial benefit, quality and service improvement, risk reduction, and control effectiveness.**
* ### **Ensure appropriate human oversight, data handling, controls, governance, and sustainable operational ownership are incorporated into AI and automation solutions.**

  

### **PORTFOLIO, PRIORITIZATION & GOVERNANCE**

  
  

* ### **Maintain visibility across assigned strategic projects, transformation initiatives, and technology-enabled work and identify dependencies or conflicts across the portfolio.**
* ### **Partner with leadership to evaluate and prioritize initiatives based on strategic alignment, business impact, risk, resource requirements, dependencies, and expected return.**
* ### **Provide leadership with clear recommendations when competing priorities, capacity constraints, risks, or dependencies require trade-off decisions.**
* ### **Establish reporting that provides concise visibility into project health, milestones, risks, decisions, dependencies, benefits, and outcomes.**
* ### **Identify patterns across projects and operational issues that indicate broader systemic risks or improvement opportunities.**

  

### **STAKEHOLDER & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

  
  

* ### **Build effective partnerships across Health, Corporate Payments, Mobility, Product, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Commercial, and other functions required to deliver complex initiatives.**
* ### **Lead cross-functional working sessions, governance forums, and executive discussions that drive decisions, resolve barriers, and maintain accountability.**
* ### **Translate complex operational, technical, financial, and project information into clear options and recommendations for senior leadership.

Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate's assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we're supporting a multinational Alzheimer's trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we're not just imagining the future of brain health - we're building it.

That's why we're seeking a Clinical Operations Coordinator, accountable for supporting the operational delivery of a variety of contracted services in a Clinical Trial. These services include Rater Training and Monitoring activities (training deployment, management, and in-study reporting/calibration), Clinician Network Management (ensuring quality and consistency across global clinical interviews), Data Management (opening and resolving data queries), and Scale Management (binder creation, translations, logistics & shipping).

The daily workload for the above functional areas will fluctuate throughout the life cycle of a Clinical Trial. The Clinical Operations Coordinator will be cross trained to support multiple functional areas, flexibly jumping in to assist study teams according to their changing bandwidth needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with study teams across a variety of functional areas to ease bandwidth strain on Coordinator responsibilities detailed below.
* Processing clinician/rater forms and documenting data via status trackers and ePortal/LMS training systems.
* Review and process submitted clinician/rater surveys and deploy applicable LMS training modules.
* Schedule 1:1 training video conferences between site raters and Cogstate Rater Services staff
* Hardware shipment scheduling and documentation management.
* Documenting real time updates to applicable status trackers, coordinating high volume email correspondence, communicating status updates to clinicians/raters, electronic records filing.
* Point of contact for clinician/rater support questions.
* Direct communication with site coordinators at clinical settings, activity and communication tracking and general support throughout study.
* Interact with CRAs for site monitoring activities.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or 1+ years of related experience.
* Previous project management or administrative support experience preferable
* Microsoft Office proficiency.

**What's In It For You**

* In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in Cogstate's short-term incentive (STI) bonus program, with a target bonus opportunity of 5% of annual base salary, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan.
* Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
* Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
* 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate's 401k program.
* Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
* Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
* Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
* Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
* Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.

**Our Culture**  
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We're courageous and we deliver together. We're passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We're brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you're ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

jobs.description:
*USA (Remote)*

**Job Description**
-------------------

Founded in 2008, OPTiMO is an experienced consulting firm specializing in world-class, enterprise-level application development, system integration, and digital design. Our clients span the public and private sector, and we strive for excellence both in our design work and service to our clients.

We are looking to add experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Analysts to support a client SAP migration-to-cloud initiative. In this role, the QA Analyst will evaluate products, systems, integrations, and business processes to ensure they meet requirements and quality standards throughout migration and release activities.

The QA Analyst will develop and execute test cases and scripts, document results and defects, support end-to-end validation, collaborate with functional and technical teams, and retest fixes. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and consistent communication with project team members and client stakeholders. SAP experience is desired.

### **Requirements**

* BA/BS degree.
* At least 5 years of Quality Assurance/software testing experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience appropriate to the assignment.
* Experience working with small teams in dynamic environments with regular client and project-team interaction.
* Strong analytical and technical skills to identify, reproduce, document, and troubleshoot issues.
* Experience developing and executing software test plans, test cases, and test scripts from requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and enhancement requests.
* Experience documenting and communicating test results, defects, supporting evidence, retest results, and testing status.
* Demonstrated knowledge of test methodologies including functional, integration, regression, system, end-to-end, and user acceptance support testing as applicable.
* Ability to participate in all phases of the testing lifecycle and collaborate with developers, business analysts, systems analysts, business users, and other functional and technical resources.
* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile or other structured delivery methodologies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and meticulous attention to detail.

### **QA Testing Responsibilities**

* Review requirements, designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, interfaces, and business processes to understand expected behavior and identify test conditions.
* Develop, maintain, and execute test cases and scripts for functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and migration-related validation activities.
* Validate business processes, system behavior, interfaces, integrations, and data as applicable to the assigned test scope.
* Identify and document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, supporting evidence, severity/impact information, and traceability to applicable requirements.
* Collaborate with functional and technical teams to investigate defects, support issue resolution, and retest fixes.
* Perform regression testing to identify unintended impacts from changes and defect corrections.
* Maintain testing evidence, test results, traceability, and other QA artifacts in accordance with project processes.
* Communicate testing progress, blockers, risks, defects, and observations to the QA Lead and applicable project stakeholders.
* Participate in requirements/design reviews, defect triage, working sessions, demonstrations, and other project activities as needed.
* Support reusable test assets, lessons learned, and continuous improvement of project testing practices.

### **Desired Skills**

* Experience testing SAP solutions, SAP implementations, upgrades, or migration initiatives.
* Experience supporting cloud migration, modernization, or large enterprise system integration efforts.
* Experience validating data migration, interfaces, integrations, batch processes, and end-to-end business workflows.
* Experience with automated software testing tools or frameworks; automation experience is desired where applicable.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar requirements, test management, collaboration, and defect-tracking platforms.
* Experience supporting federal government or other large enterprise programs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office platform.

### **USPS Requirements**

* United States citizen, permanent resident, or citizen of American Samoa or other U.S. territory.
* Recent employment history.
* Ability to pass a criminal background check, drug screening, and medical assessment.
* Background checks are conducted using United States information resources only, including FBI fingerprint checks and applicable state and county checks. A criminal background check involves a five-year inquiry for any location where the individual has resided, worked, or attended school within the United States or its territories.
* Individuals who have not resided in the United States or its territories for the preceding five years may not have a complete background investigation unless their time outside the country qualifies under applicable USPS requirements.
* Residency requirement for background checks.
* Must be registered with Selective Service if applicable.

For more information about OPTiMO, visit the company website: www.OPTiMO-IT.com

jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Manager, Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance (Biologics) drives complex FDA regulatory submissions for biologic programs, from Phase 1 through marketing applications (BLA/NDA). At Natera, we move fast because there is a patient waiting for every test and treatment. In this role, you will build and own quality systems, translate executive strategy into compliant submissions, and provide regulatory guidance to ensure rapid product approvals. You will coordinate risk assessments balancing technical impact, patient safety, and regulatory compliance.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Turn executive strategy, development priorities, and target product profiles into actionable regulatory plans and submissions.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of FDCA, PHS Act Section 351, 21 CFR, and FDA/ICH guidance to build submissions that meet current agency expectations.
* Guide cross-functional teams in preparation for pre-IND/INTERACT and FDA meeting requests (Type A/B/C/D, pre-BLA/NDA).
* Author and review CMC (Module 3), nonclinical (Modules 2.4/2.6, 4), or clinical (Modules 2.5/2.7, 5) components of regulatory submissions.
* Support RA leadership in maintaining INDs, including protocol amendments, safety reports, and change notifications.
* Prepare briefing materials, question strategies, and tracking minutes for FDA meetings.
* Draft technical responses to FDA information requests and clinical holds.
* Represent Regulatory Affairs on program teams to ensure deliverables meet regulatory requirements with the least-burdensome approaches.
* Own core quality system processes, including CAPA, nonconformance reports (NCRs), change control, and SOP management.
* Build and maintain agile quality systems that ensure compliance without slowing down our ability to deliver critical products.
* Support FDA and CDMO inspection readiness (PAI/PLI, BIMO) through mock inspections and document preparation.
* Manage and develop a team of quality and regulatory professionals as business needs require.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* B.S., M.S., or equivalent in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or Engineering (experience may substitute for education).
* 5-8 years of biotech or pharma industry experience in regulatory affairs, including Phase 1 IND through marketing application. Biologics experience preferred.
* Hands-on experience with eCTD and FDA ESG submissions.
* Working knowledge of FDA biologics regulations (21 CFR Parts 11, 50, 56, 58, 210/211, 312, 600-610) and ICH guidelines.
* Direct experience managing CAPA, NCR, and change control in an electronic QMS.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Capable of operating independently and building structure where it is missing.
* Strong scientific writing and risk assessment skills, relying on evidence and data to make decisions.
* Clear, proactive communicator who adapts quickly to shifting priorities.
* Experience with CBER- or CDER-regulated biologics (monoclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins, cell/gene therapy).
* RAC certification or ASQ CQA/CQE is a plus.
* CDMO oversight and phase-appropriate GMP experience.

**OUR OPPORTUNITY**

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

* Fluent English, with strong written, presentation and executive communication skills. Additional languages are an advantage for global accounts
* Credibility with technical and business audiences. You can work with architects and developers, advise program and product leaders, and engage procurement and executives with clear, practical recommendations
* Business acumen: you understand how location technology creates operational, product and commercial value, and you explain it in the customer's language
* Leadership without a reporting line: you align account teams, product groups, delivery teams, support functions and partners around one plan, using evidence, preparation and clear ownership
* Strong judgment, autonomy and comfort with change. You can prioritize across competing customer needs, surface risk early and stay effective in an evolving organization
* Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings, workshops, executive reviews and internal planning

### **What you'll do**

* Build the account and success plan with the account manager: understand the customer's strategy, identify priority business outcomes and use cases, map whitespace across business units and regions, and define the revenue opportunities we will pursue together. * Create the next conversation before the customer asks: bring TomTom's product roadmaps, partner capabilities and new offerings to the customer as relevant proposals, run executive and strategic business reviews, and turn customer insights into qualified opportunities with clear value, sponsorship and next steps
* Know the customer's business, organization, technology environment and constraints better than anyone at TomTom, and translate those insights into decisions and actions our product and delivery teams can take
* Shape the solution with product, engineering and delivery teams before commitments are made, ensuring that scope, outcomes, dependencies, security needs and delivery capacity are understood

**Location**
------------

Remote - United States

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Customer Success

  

**About You**

You’re a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You’re a self-starter who’s good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You’ve worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they’re happy they partnered with you. Further, you’re a curious person, and you’d love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge.

**About Us**
------------

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.
  
  
Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and with customers across many countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.
  
  
We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.
  
  
Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

**About the Position**

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

* Repaying our customers’ trust through ensuring they get live with our product and are thrilled with the results
* Understand the needs and roles within the enterprise organizations we work with and help to manage prioritizations and misalignments. If two people within a customer ask for different things, your team must understand how to prioritize for the success of the organization without hurting feelings
* Helping craft and dictate both internal and external narratives for what’s needed to make a customer successful
* Effectively asking for and managing engineering time to ensure important work for customers is prioritized and unimportant requests are resolved with minimal to no engineering resources
* Fielding and troubleshooting customer support requests
* Creating and updating customer documentation and training materials as needed
* Always looking for new ways you can make our integration process more robust and make customers feel even more successful

  

**Requirements**

* A minimum of three years professional experience dealing directly with customers and large organizations in a role within customer success, technical account management, or solutions consulting
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Know what an API is and have interacted with them before
* Excellent ability to quickly understand the different roles in an organization, focus on the ones most important to a task, and craft clear narrative to get people behind your ideas
* Ability to convince and motivate those around you to do what you know is right
* Enjoy interacting with customers and solving new problems daily
* Ability and desire to learn quickly, think outside the box, and come up with solutions to problems

**How we handle your data.** By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

jobs.title: Call Center Manager
jobs.description:
**Call Center Manager**
-----------------------

**Omari Construction Group – Remote**  
**Job Type:** Full-Time Independent Contractor (1099)  
**Compensation:** $50,000–$60,000 annually + bonuses

**About Us**
------------

Omari Construction is a growing construction company specializing in commercial construction, luxury residential design-build, and exterior remodeling and insurance restoration. We are committed to delivering exceptional service, operational excellence, and results across every division.

At Omari, we value **integrity, innovation, and performance**. We are seeking motivated professionals who take ownership, lead with accountability, and thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

**About the Position**
----------------------

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and results-driven **Call Center Manager** to build, lead, and optimize our outbound call center operations.

This individual will be responsible for managing call center representatives, developing effective lead-generation strategies, overseeing appointment scheduling, maintaining accurate CRM records, and driving measurable performance.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong call center management experience, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to develop scalable processes that support company growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Call Center Leadership & Operations**

* Build, manage, and continuously improve daily call center operations.
* Recruit, onboard, train, and coach call center representatives.
* Establish daily calling priorities, performance expectations, and accountability measures.
* Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions.
* Develop call scripts, training materials, and standardized operating procedures.
* Ensure consistent call center coverage and efficient appointment scheduling.

**Lead Generation & Appointment Management**

* Oversee outbound calling campaigns to generate qualified appointments for insurance inspections and retail home improvement estimates.
* Identify, evaluate, and manage quality lead sources and calling lists.
* Monitor lead quality, appointment conversion rates, and follow-up activity.
* Coordinate with sales leadership to ensure appointments are properly scheduled, tracked, and completed.
* Maintain accurate lead records, call dispositions, and appointment outcomes.
* Optimize calling strategies to improve contact rates and appointment performance.

**Performance Tracking & Reporting**

* Monitor daily call volume, representative productivity, appointment conversion rates, and no-show rates.
* Review daily and weekly call center performance reports.
* Maintain individual representative scorecards and identify coaching opportunities.
* Provide weekly performance updates to company leadership.
* Develop automated reporting tools and dashboards to track department performance.

**Systems Management & Process Improvement**

* Oversee the administration and optimization of RingCentral, RingCX, and related communication systems.
* Maintain accurate customer and appointment records within AccuLynx CRM.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI tools, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive Call Center Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure calling lists, CRM records, and reporting systems remain accurate and organized.
* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and operations teams to improve efficiency and customer experience.

**Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Monitor call quality, representative performance, and adherence to company standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable telemarketing regulations, including Do Not Call requirements.
* Review call outcomes, lead classifications, and appointment records for accuracy.
* Identify operational issues and implement corrective action.
* Maintain a high standard of professionalism and customer communication.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5+ years of experience in call center operations, outbound sales, telemarketing, or appointment setting.
* 2+ years of experience managing or supervising a call center team.
* Demonstrated success improving call center productivity, appointment conversion, and team performance.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and team-development skills.
* Experience managing outbound calling campaigns and lead-generation strategies.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms, call center software, and performance reporting tools.
* Experience with RingCentral, RingCX, AccuLynx, or similar platforms preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet performance objectives.
* Experience in construction, home improvement, roofing, or insurance restoration is a plus.

**Performance Expectations**
----------------------------

Success in this position will be measured by the ability to develop a productive, efficient, and scalable call center operation.

Key performance objectives include:

* Supporting representative productivity targets of approximately **200–300 outbound dials per day**.
* Driving an average of **2–4 qualified appointments per representative per day**.
* Maintaining accurate CRM records and complete call dispositions.
* Improving appointment completion rates and minimizing no-shows.
* Delivering consistent, accurate weekly reporting.
* Developing documented processes that support long-term operational growth.

**Compensation & Performance Bonus**
------------------------------------

**Base Compensation: $50,000–$60,000 annually**, based on experience and qualifications.

In addition to base compensation, this position offers the opportunity to earn **up to $30,000 in annual performance-based bonuses**, subject to the terms of the applicable compensation agreement.

**About Delinea:**  
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

**Technical Account Manager Position Summary**

80% of breaches involve privileged credential misuse. Delinea, the leader in Cloud-Ready Privilege Access Management is ready to help minimize the potential attack surface. As such, we are seeking an experienced and self-driven Technical Account Manager to join our outstanding Customer Success team. **50-75% travel** throughout the United States and Canada, including customer visits, industry events, trade shows, and internal meetings.

jobs.title: Freight Support Manager
jobs.description:
**Freight Support Manager**

**Company:** Transportli  
**Website:** transportli.com  
**Industry:** Transportation Technology & Logistics  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** Remote

**About Transportli**

Transportli is an online shipping marketplace connecting individuals and businesses with transportation providers across the United States.

Our platform helps customers compare shipping quotes, communicate with carriers, and arrange transportation services, including Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) freight, expedited shipping, and auto transport.

We’re building a simpler, more transparent shipping experience through technology, competitive pricing, and reliable customer support.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused **Freight Support Manager** to oversee customer support operations and help ensure a smooth shipping experience for customers and transportation providers using the Transportli marketplace.

The ideal candidate has experience in freight transportation, strong communication skills, and the ability to resolve shipping-related issues efficiently.

This role involves assisting customers with shipping requests, coordinating communication between marketplace participants, monitoring shipment progress, and improving customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Support & Freight Assistance**

* Respond to customer inquiries via email, live chat, and phone.
* Assist customers with shipping requests, quotes, and booking procedures.
* Explain freight transportation options, transit times, and service requirements.
* Help customers understand LTL freight classifications, packaging requirements, and accessorial charges.
* Resolve customer concerns related to pickups, deliveries, and shipment updates.

**Carrier Communication**

* Communicate with transportation providers regarding shipment availability and service details.
* Facilitate communication between customers and carriers.
* Assist with pickup and delivery scheduling.
* Monitor shipment progress and provide timely updates.
* Escalate service disruptions, delays, and transportation-related issues.

**Shipment Support & Documentation**

* Review shipment information for accuracy and completeness.
* Assist customers with Bills of Lading (BOLs), Proofs of Delivery (PODs), and shipping documentation.
* Support customers with freight damage reports, billing discrepancies, and service complaints.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and customer communication histories.

**Marketplace Operations**

* Monitor incoming shipping requests and customer inquiries.
* Follow up with customers who have received quotes but have not completed bookings.
* Identify opportunities to improve quote acceptance and booking conversion rates.
* Help transportation providers navigate the Transportli platform.
* Collaborate with the product and operations teams to improve marketplace functionality.

**Performance & Quality Management**

* Maintain high customer satisfaction and response-time standards.
* Track support performance, recurring issues, and customer feedback.
* Develop and improve customer support procedures.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.
* Prepare periodic reports on support activities and performance.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in freight transportation, logistics operations, or customer support.
* Understanding of U.S. freight transportation, particularly LTL and expedited shipping.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities.
* Experience working with CRM systems, transportation management systems, or customer support software.
* Ability to handle multiple customer requests and prioritize urgent issues.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with U.S. freight carriers and transportation marketplaces.
* Knowledge of LTL freight classes, NMFC classifications, and accessorial charges.
* Experience in auto transport or expedited freight operations.
* Familiarity with freight claims and shipping documentation.
* Experience improving customer conversion rates and retention.
* Previous experience with digital marketplaces or logistics technology platforms.

**What We Offer**

* Remote work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a growing transportation technology platform.
* Collaborative and supportive team.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* Direct involvement in improving customer experience and marketplace operations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Success in this role will be measured through:

* **First Response Time:** Speed of responding to customer inquiries.
* **Customer Satisfaction (CSAT):** Quality of customer support interactions.
* **Quote-to-Booking Conversion:** Percentage of shipping requests converted into bookings.
* **Issue Resolution Time:** Efficiency in resolving customer and shipment-related issues.
* **Shipment Support Quality:** Accuracy of shipment information and timely communication.
* **Customer Retention:** Percentage of customers returning to use the platform.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief introduction highlighting their experience in U.S. freight transportation and customer support.

**Join Transportli and help us make freight shipping simpler, more transparent, and accessible to everyone.**

Pay: $50,000.00 - $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

At Rhythm, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of energy while building products, systems, and experiences that make a difference for our customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring an **Operations Analyst** to help manage and improve the systems and workflows that connect Rhythm with our utilities, vendors, and external partners.

You'll take ownership of critical operational processes, including transaction exceptions, failed orders, and customer-initiated requests. Working across internal teams and external partners, you'll investigate issues, resolve exceptions, and ensure our operations run accurately and efficiently.

This role goes beyond day-to-day execution. You'll analyze operational data, identify recurring issues, and help implement improvements that enable Rhythm to grow and scale.

We're looking for someone who's analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to build a career in operations within a fast-growing energy company.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own and manage operational workflows, including account exceptions, failed orders, and customer-initiated requests.
* Work with our Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) vendor, utilities, and internal teams to investigate and resolve transaction exceptions.
* Analyze operational data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
* Communicate system bugs, operational risks, and business feedback to internal stakeholders and department leadership.
* Support operational requests within established service-level agreements (SLAs), ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Partner with your manager and cross-functional teams to execute prioritized initiatives and meet deadlines.
* Document workflows, processes, and resolutions to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 1+ year of experience in backend operations, transaction management, operational workflows, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Excel and comfort working with operational data and reporting tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to learn new systems, processes, and technologies quickly.
* A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* A collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a genuine interest in continuous improvement.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in retail energy, electricity supply, utilities, or another transaction-intensive industry.
* Familiarity with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) systems and transaction management.
* Experience with customer service ticketing platforms, EDI management software, or data visualization tools.
* Experience testing operational workflows and documenting business processes.
* Interest in renewable energy, sustainability, and energy innovation.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Operational workflows and transaction exceptions are managed accurately and within established SLAs.
* Failed orders and account exceptions are investigated and resolved with minimal disruption to customers and internal teams.
* Recurring operational issues are identified through data analysis and translated into actionable improvements.
* Processes become more efficient, reliable, and scalable as Rhythm grows.
* Internal teams and external partners receive clear, timely communication on issues and resolutions.
* You independently manage your responsibilities and become a trusted contributor to the Operations team.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**
--------------------------------

* **Meaningful ownership.** Manage critical processes that directly impact Rhythm's customers and business operations.
* **Career growth.** Build your expertise in operations, energy markets, systems integration, and process improvement.
* **Analytical challenges.** Investigate complex issues, work with operational data, and turn insights into improvements.
* **Cross-functional exposure.** Collaborate with internal teams, utilities, vendors, and external partners.
* **Remote flexibility.** Work remotely within the United States while contributing to a collaborative team.
* **Our culture.** We're friendly, transparent, and value curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.
* **Make a difference.** Help build a more efficient, technology-driven energy company focused on a sustainable future.

jobs.title: Communications Operations Associate
jobs.description:
The Environmental Protection Network (EPN) is composed of more than 800 EPA alumni from across the country who volunteer their time to protect the integrity of EPA and its mission. We harness the expertise of former EPA career staff and confirmation-level appointees from Democratic and Republican administrations to provide the unique perspective of former regulators with decades of historical knowledge and subject matter expertise.

EPN is currently focused on building, defending and reimagining the capacity of environmental health agencies and the communities they serve to truly address the most urgent health and environmental crises.

* We work to ensure that EPA advances policies, programs, budgets, and institutional changes to address climate and environmental injustices, as well as other pressing public health needs.
* We provide pro bono capacity-building technical assistance and training to frontline communities, NGOs, and under-resourced state/local/tribal government agencies.
* We offer pro bono support to civil servants.
* We educate Congress and serve as a critical resource for facts, objective analysis, and scientific rigor for reporters and NGOs.

**Priority Deadline December 4th**

**About The Position:**

Effective public communication is central to EPN's mission. Our Public Affairs team helps people understand how EPA's work affects their health, communities, and daily lives, while bringing independent expertise to discussions about how environmental protections can meet changing political, economic, and technological realities. Behind timely media responses, effective outreach, and clear public-facing materials are dependable systems and careful coordination.

EPN is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Communications Operations Associate to make that work possible. As a central coordinator and project manager for our growing Public Affairs team, this person will connect people, information, deadlines, and deliverables; anticipate needs; and keep important work moving. The role combines communications workflow management, reporter intake and follow-up, managing contact and media-tracking databases, publication and distribution of communications materials, proactive scheduling and administrative support. Reporting to EPN's Senior Director of Public Affairs, the Associate works with communications and policy staff, volunteer experts, and outside partners to ensure accurate, timely execution.

### **1. Communications Workflow and Project Coordination-**

* Independently coordinate the Public Affairs team's day-to-day workflow, maintaining an up-to-date Asana task tracker and editorial/production calendar for releases, newsletters, campaigns, and other deliverables.
* Track assignments, owners, approvals, dependencies, and deadlines; anticipate competing demands, identify bottlenecks, and help resolve routine conflicts before they delay work.
* Coordinate handoffs among communications staff, policy colleagues, volunteers, and outside contractors; follow up proactively and close the loop on outstanding tasks.
* Document and improve repeatable workflows, checklists, templates, and team systems.

### **2. Administrative and Scheduling Support-**

* Provide proactive administrative and scheduling support to Public Affairs leadership and the broader team, coordinating meetings and interviews across multiple calendars and participants.
* Manage invitations, meeting links, reminders, agendas, shared materials, notes, and action items as needed; follow through on next steps.
* Organize shared files, contacts, and distribution lists; prepare materials and handle routine logistical requests with accuracy and discretion.
* Anticipate routine needs, recognize when competing requests require a decision, and raise issues promptly with the appropriate colleagues.
